hotels.title: Stylish Bahamas Beachfront Indulgence with Three Pools, Spa & Night Club
hotels.description: Soak up Caribbean beachfront bliss from this sleek seafront hotspot, where signature SLS hospitality meets sun-soaked style. Overlooking sugar‑white sands and turquoise waters, this resort is set within the buzzy Baha Mar complex. Spend sun-drenched days at the adults-only Privilege pool, sip on mouthwatering cocktails or take a stroll to the beach just steps away. Dining here is a highlight, with various restaurants offering everything from Mediterranean favourites at Cleo to coastal fare at 25° North. As the sun sets, the vibe shifts, welcoming rooftop revelry at Skybar and underground beats at the Bond nightclub. Whether you're here for the star-powered hangouts or refined beachside living, this is island luxury at its best.
